title: OAG Handshake Profile v1.0
description: Optional mutual authentication handshake profile for the Open Agent Governance Specification. Defines a 3-step nonce-based challenge-response protocol using Ed25519 signatures. Conformance level: Optional (MAY implement).

hello.description: Step 1: Client sends HELLO with a random nonce to the agent's /.well-known/oag/hello endpoint

welcome.description: Step 2: Agent responds with its identity, its own nonce, and a signature over the client's nonce

signature_c.description: Ed25519 signature over the raw client_nonce bytes (not hex), hex-encoded

credentials.description: List of verifiable credentials (JWTs or badge identifiers)

auth.description: Step 3: Client signs the agent's nonce and sends AUTH to the agent's /.well-known/oag/auth endpoint

signature_a.description: Ed25519 signature over the agent_nonce UTF-8 bytes, hex-encoded
